name: openclaw
title: OpenClaw
description: Manage your OpenClaw gateway: status, sessions, logs and restart
author: dofy

commands.name: status
commands.title: OpenClaw Status
commands.description: View gateway health and channel status

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: OpenClaw Sessions
commands.description: List active agent sessions and token usage

preferences.name: binPath
preferences.title: OpenClaw Binary Path
preferences.description: Use auto to discover openclaw, or enter an absolute executable path.

preferences.name: logPath
preferences.title: Log File Path
preferences.description: Use auto to discover logs, or enter an absolute log file path. ~/ is supported.
preferences.placeholder: Automatic (or full path to a log file)

preferences.name: stateDirectory
preferences.title: State Directory
preferences.description: auto inherits OpenClaw environment and defaults. Set a path to use a specific local instance.

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: Config File Path
preferences.description: auto inherits the OpenClaw configuration. A custom path affects CLI commands only.

preferences.name: additionalPath
preferences.title: Additional Executable Paths
preferences.description: Extra directories for CLI or Node discovery, separated by colons. ~/ is supported.

preferences.name: dailyLogDirectory
preferences.title: Diagnostic Log Directory
preferences.description: Directory containing openclaw-YYYY-MM-DD.log files. The latest dated file is used as a fallback.

preferences.name: commandTimeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Command Timeout (Seconds)
preferences.description: Applies to status, sessions, restart and cleanup. Range: 1–300.

preferences.name: commandOutputMiB
preferences.title: CLI Output Limit (MiB)
preferences.description: Maximum captured CLI response size. Range: 1–16.

preferences.name: logEntryLimit
preferences.title: Log Entry Limit
preferences.description: Maximum recent records before grouping. Range: 1–1000.

preferences.name: logReadKiB
preferences.title: Log Read Window (KiB)
preferences.description: Maximum file tail size to read. Range: 16–4096.

preferences.name: defaultLogLevel
preferences.title: Default Log Level
preferences.description: Initial log filter when opening Logs.

preferences.name: groupRepeatedLogs
preferences.title: Group Repeated Logs
preferences.description: Combine repeated records while preserving every raw entry in details.
preferences.label: Group repeated messages

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
